paite: Judahte kumpipa, Jehoiakim, Josiah tapa kum lina a Judah mite tengteng tungtang a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung; huai hun bel Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kum khatna ahi a,
heading: Mallam A Kipan A Melma
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (the same was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),

paite: huai thu zawlnei Jeremiah in Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a om tengtengte kiang a agen ahi.
english: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:

paite: Kum sawmnih-le-thum sung, Judahte kumpipa Josiah, Ammon tapa kum sawm-le-thumna a kipan tutan in, TOUPA thu ahong tung zel a, phalvak a thou in na kiang uah ka gengen a, himahleh na ngaikhe kei uh.
english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, the word of Yahweh has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.

paite: TOUPA'N na kiang uah anasemmi zawlneite tengteng asawl a, phalvak a thou in asawl a, himahleh na ngaikhe kei ua, thei ding in na bil uh na doh sam kei uh.
english: Yahweh has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened, nor inclined your ear to hear)

paite: Huai, zawlneite'n, "Michih noumau lampi gilou a kipan hong kik unla, TOUPA'N na kiang ua leh na pipute uh kiang a nidanglai a kipan tangtawn a ding a nou ahon piak gam ah teng un.
english: saying, Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forevermore;

paite: Pathian dangte kiang ah a-nna uh sem ding leh amaute be ding leh na khut nasep ua kei hon lungkim lousak ding in hoh kei un; huchi in ka hon hihna kei ding hi," achi uh.
english: and don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; and I will do you no harm.

paite: Himahleh nou ding a hoih lou ding a na khut nasep ua hon hehsak ding in na hon ngaikhe kei uh, TOUPA'N achi.
english: Yet you have not listened to me, says Yahweh; that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.

paite: "Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ka thu na ngaihkhiak louh ziak un, ngai dih ua,
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies: Because you have not heard my words,

paite: mallam nam tengteng ka thukhak ding a, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi. Ka nasempa Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leng ka thukhak ding a, amaute hiai gam leh asung a omte leh hiai kim a nam om tengteng sual ding in ka hon pi ding; ka hihmang sipsip ding a, lamdangsak ding leh enghou ding leh segawp nilouh ding in ka bawl ding.
english: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, says Yahweh, and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around; and I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.

paite: Huan akiang ua kipan nopsakna husa leh kipahna husate, mouneipa aw leh mou awte, buhgawi husa ging leh khawnvak vakte ka lamang ding hi.
english: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.

paite: Hiai avek in ase ding a, lamdangsak ahi ding a; hiai namte'n Babulon kumpipa nna kum sawmsagih asem ding uh.
english: This whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

paite: Huan kum sawmsagih aman hun chiang in Babulon kumpipa leh huai nam, Kaldaite gam, agitlouhna uh ziak in ka gawt ding a; tangtawn in ka segawpsak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: It shall happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, says Yahweh, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans; and I will make it desolate forever.

paite: Huai gam tung ah ka thu atung ua ka gen tengteng, Jeremiah in namte tung a agen, hiai laibu a gelhsa tengteng ka tungsak ding hi.
english: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

paite: Nam tuamtuam leh kumpipa thupitakte'n amaute'n nna akisep un, amau mahmah in leng amau nna ahon sepsak ding uhi.
english: For many nations and great kings shall make bondservants of them, even of them; and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Ka khut a hiai hehna uain nou la inla, ka hon sawlna ding nam chih dawnsak in.
heading: Namte Tung A Pathian Thukhenna
english: For thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, to me: take this cup of the wine of wrath at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send you, to drink it.

paite: Adawn ding ua, ahoi dongdong ding ua, ahai ding ua, akiang ua ka sawl ding namsau ziak in," chi in.
english: They shall drink, and reel back and forth, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA khut a kipan nou ka la a, TOUPA'N hon sawlna nam chih ka dawnsak hi.
english: Then took I the cup at Yahweh’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom Yahweh had sent me:

paite: Jerusalem leh Judah khopite, huai kumpipate leh heutute, siatgawpnate, lamdangsakte, enghou dingte, hamsiatte tang ding in, tua a-omdan bang uh;
english: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and its kings, and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is this day;

paite: Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh leh asikhate, aheutute leh ami tengtengte;
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;

paite: Amau lak a mikitokpolh tengteng; Uz gam a kumpipa teng; Philistia gam a kumpipa tengteng, Ashkelon leh Gaza leh Ekron leh Ashdod khosuaksunte;
english: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of the Uz, and all the kings of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

paite: Edom leh Moab leh Ammon suante;
english: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon;

paite: Tura kumpipa tengteng leh Sidon kumpipate leh tuipi gei kumpipate;
english: and all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;

paite: Dedan leh Tema leh Buz leh abaksam uh met a omte tengteng;
english: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;

paite: Arabia kumpipa tengteng, Gamdai a teng nam kihelte kumpipate;
english: and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;

paite: Zimri kumpipa tengteng; Elam kumpipa tengteng; Media kumpipa tengteng;
english: and all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

paite: Mallam kumpipa tengteng, agamla leh anai a mi akizom zel in; leitung a kumpi om tengteng in adawn khit chiang in Seshak kumpipa'n adawn ding hi.
english: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

paite: Huan akiang uah sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Dawn unla, kham un, lau unla, kipuk in thoutou nawn kei un; na lak ua namsau ka sawl ding ziak in," chi in.
english: You shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

paite: Huan na khut a nou pen dawn ding a alak nop kei uleh huchi in na chi ding; sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na dawn ngeingei ding uh ahi!
english: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies: You shall surely drink.

paite: Ka min tam khopi ah thil hoih lou ka hih pan a, noute gawt louh hial in na om ding uh maw? Gawt louh in na om kei ding ua; lei a teng tengteng tung ah namsau ka samkhe ding," chih sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huaiziak in atung ah hiaite gen inla, akiang uah huchi in chi in: "TOUPA mun sang a kipan in athum ding, atenna siangthou a kipan a-aw asuah ding, ahuang tung ah nakpi in athum ding; grep suk mite bang in akikou ding, lei luahte teng tung ah.
english: Therefore prophesy you against them all these words, and tell them, Yahweh will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he will mightily roar against his fold; he will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

paite: Lei tawp pha in husa athangkik ding a, TOUPA'N namte alang a, sa tengteng tung ah vai ahawm ding, namsau kiang ah migilou ape ding," TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: A noise shall come even to the end of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with the nations; he will enter into judgment with all flesh: as for the wicked, he will give them to the sword, says Yahweh.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai in, thil hoih lou in nam chih ahon nuai ding hi, huihpi hat mahmah lei mun tawp a kipan in ahong kuan ding hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great storm shall be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA thahte'n lei tawp a kipan in lei tawp pha in akhak ding ua; suun louh leh khop louh leh vui louh in a-om ding ua; leitung a eklei lel ahi maimah ding uh.
english: The slain of Yahweh shall be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung on the surface of the ground.

paite: "Belamching mite aw kikou tuaituai unla, kap un, nou belamhon lak a makaite aw, kitung buatbuat un, thah a na om ni uleh na dalhzak nite uh ahong tung petmahta hi. Bel deihhuai bang in na puk ding uh.
english: Wail, you shepherds, and cry; and wallow in dust, you principal of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are fully come, and you shall fall like a goodly vessel.

paite: Belamching mite'n taimangna lampi anei kei ding ua, belamhon lak a makaite'n leng pelhna lampi anei kei ding uh.
english: The shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

paite: Belamching mite kah husa, belamhon lak a makaite mau ging toh, TOUPA'N atatna mun uh asuksiat lel ziak in.
english: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the principal of the flock! for Yahweh lays waste their pasture.

paite: Huang muanhuaite daihsak sipsip in a-omta uh, TOUPA heh mahmah ziak in.
english: The peaceable folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.

paite: Abukna pawtsanta, humpinelkai bang in, nuaisiahna namsau lauhuai ziak leh aheh mahmah ziak in agam uh ase khinta hi."
english: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.
